name: t212-mcp-server

tools.name: fetch-open-positions
tools.description: Fetch all open investment positions with current price, P/L, and wallet impact

tools.name: fetch-position
tools.description: Fetch a specific open position by ticker

tools.name: fetch-all-pies
tools.description: [DEPRECATED] Fetch all pies. A pie is a collection of securities - stocks & ETFs. This endpoint is deprecated by Trading 212 and may be removed in the future.

tools.name: fetch-account-summary
tools.description: Fetch Trading212 account summary including cash balance, investment value, and profit/loss

tools.name: search-instruments
tools.description: Search for tradeable instruments (stocks, ETFs, warrants) by name, ticker, or ISIN. Returns up to 50 matching results.

query.description: Search term to filter instruments by ticker or name (case-insensitive)

type.description: Filter by instrument type (e.g. STOCK, ETF, WARRANT, CRYPTO, INDEX, FOREX, FUTURES, CVR, CORPACT)

tools.name: fetch-exchanges
tools.description: Fetch all available exchanges and their working schedules, including next open/close times

tools.name: fetch-order-history
tools.description: Fetch historical order data with optional pagination and ticker filter. Returns filled orders with price, quantity, and timing details.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextPagePath

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

tools.name: fetch-dividend-history
tools.description: Fetch historical dividend payments with optional pagination and ticker filter. Returns dividend amount, quantity, and payment date.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextPagePath

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

tools.name: fetch-transaction-history
tools.description: Fetch account transaction history (deposits, withdrawals) with optional pagination.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextPagePath

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

tools.name: fetch-exports
tools.description: List all CSV account export reports with their status and download links
